pairs.target: kàn zhǎn guòhòu de dìèrtiān , mǐlā háishì qù jiè le luò hēng de shì cáo .
pairs.english: On the second day after the exhibition, Mira went to borrow Lohen’s test trough after all.
pairs.hanzi: 看展过后的第二天，米拉还是去借了洛亨的试槽。

pairs.target: tā jiào tǎ wéi bāngmáng bān , dào le gébì gōngpéng , què xiān zhàn zài ménwài děng .
pairs.english: She asked Tavi to help carry it, but when they reached the next workshop she waited outside the door first.
pairs.hanzi: 她叫塔维帮忙搬，到了隔壁工棚，却先站在门外等。

pairs.target: luò hēng zhèng bǎ yìtiáo xì zhúpiàn xiāobáo , tīngjiàn zhāohū , táitóu shuō cáo zài qiángbiān , lǐmiàn nàtiáo huódòng shuǐdào bié chāi , zìjǐ xiàwǔ háiyào yòng .
pairs.english: Lohen was shaving a thin bamboo strip. Hearing their greeting, he looked up and said the trough was by the wall; they must not dismantle its movable channel, which he needed that afternoon.
pairs.hanzi: 洛亨正把一条细竹片削薄，听见招呼，抬头说槽在墙边，里面那条活动水道别拆，自己下午还要用。

pairs.target: shì cáo bǐ mǐlā de xiǎo cáo cháng dé duō , chūkǒu kěyǐ tiáo kuānzhǎi . shàngcì tā liúxià chǐcùn , tā yǐjīng bǐ zhe liáng guò liǎngzhī hézi .
pairs.english: The test trough was much longer than Mira’s small one, with an adjustable outlet width. She had already checked her two boxes against the dimensions he had left.
pairs.hanzi: 试槽比米拉的小槽长得多，出口可以调宽窄。上次他留下尺寸，她已经比着量过两只盒子。

pairs.target: jīntiān dàilái de dǎobǎn shì báo mùpiàn zuò de , xié fàngzài liǎnghé zhījiān , xīwàng jiāng yèbǐng tuīxiàng yìpáng , bù héng kǎ zài zhōngjiān nàtiáo biānshàng .
pairs.english: Today’s guide plate was made from thin wood, set diagonally between the boxes to push leaf stalks aside rather than let them jam crosswise on the middle edge.
pairs.hanzi: 今天带来的导板是薄木片做的，斜放在两盒之间，希望将叶柄推向一旁，不横卡在中间那条边上。

pairs.target: luò hēng fàngxià dāo , zǒuguò láikàn . " nǐ zhèyàng yí fàng , shuǐ quán wǎng zhè yìzhī lǐ qù . " " suǒyǐ cái yào shì . " mǐlā shuō .
pairs.english: Lohen set down his knife and came to look. “Put it like that and all the water goes into this box.” “That is why we need to test it,” Mira said.
pairs.hanzi:
洛亨放下刀，走过来看。
“你这样一放，水全往这一只里去。”
“所以才要试。”米拉说。

pairs.target: tā shēnshǒu xiǎng ná dǎobǎn , mǐlā ànzhù le . liǎnggè rén de shǒu gé zhe yìxiǎokuài shī mùtou tíngzhù , tǎ wéi tí zhe kōngtǒng , bù zhīdào gāi xiān chūqù , háishì jiǎzhuāng zhǎoshuǐ .
pairs.english: He reached for the guide plate, but Mira held it down. Their hands stopped on either side of a small piece of wet wood. Holding an empty bucket, Tavi wondered whether to leave first or pretend to fetch water.
pairs.hanzi: 他伸手想拿导板，米拉按住了。两个人的手隔着一小块湿木头停住，塔维提着空桶，不知道该先出去，还是假装找水。

pairs.target: luò hēng xiān sōngshǒu , shuō zìjǐ búshì yào chāi tā de dōngxī .
pairs.english: Lohen let go first, saying he was not trying to dismantle her work.
pairs.hanzi: 洛亨先松手，说自己不是要拆她的东西。

pairs.target: mǐlā shuō zhīdào , kě shēngyīn bú xiàng zhīdào . tā bǎ dǎobǎn shōuhuí hézi lǐ , wèn jiè yígè xiàwǔ gòubugòu , luò hēng shuō wǔfàn hòu nálái , wǎnzhōng qián hái , bié bǎ tā zìjǐ de kèxiàn módiào .
pairs.english: Mira said she knew, without sounding like it. She put the guide plate back in the box and asked about borrowing it for one afternoon. Lohen said to collect it after lunch and return it before the evening bell, without rubbing off his marked lines.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉说知道，可声音不像知道。她把导板收回盒子里，问借一个下午够不够，洛亨说午饭后拿来，晚钟前还，别把他自己的刻线磨掉。

pairs.target: huí dōng yuàn shí , tǎ wéi wèn tā shìbushì bùxiǎng jiè le . mǐ lāzǒu dé hěnkuài , guò le zhuǎnjiǎo cái tíngxiàlái .
pairs.english: Returning to the east courtyard, Tavi asked whether she no longer wanted to borrow it. Mira walked fast, stopping only after the corner.
pairs.hanzi: 回东院时，塔维问她是不是不想借了。米拉走得很快，过了转角才停下来。

pairs.target: " wǒ diē huíxìn , shuō zhècì túhuà dé xì . " tā shuō , " hòumiàn yòu xiě , ruòzhēn zuò déchū , ràngwǒná gěi gōngfáng kàn . tā nándé zhèyàng shuō . "
pairs.english: “My father wrote that this drawing was detailed,” she said. “Then he said if I can really build it, I should show the works. He rarely says that.”
pairs.hanzi: “我爹回信，说这次图画得细。”她说，“后面又写，若真做得出，让我拿给工房看。他难得这样说。”

pairs.target: tā jiāng shǒulǐ de dǎobǎn fānguòlái , yòu fān huíqù . " kě zài tiān yìdiǎn tā de , zài gǎi yìdiǎn biérén de , zuìhòu wǒ hái shèngxià shénme ? "
pairs.english: She turned the guide plate over in her hands, then back again. “But add some of his work, change some with somebody else’s, and what is left of mine?”
pairs.hanzi:
她将手里的导板翻过来，又翻回去。
“可再添一点他的，再改一点别人的，最后我还剩下什么？”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiǎng shuō zǒng háishì tā xiān huà de , sū yǐ què cóng hòumiàn zhuīshànglái , shǒulǐ ná zhe lòu dài de mù jiá . " nà wǒ suàn nǎyìdiǎn ? " tā wèn .
pairs.english: Tavi wanted to say she had drawn it first, but Suyi caught up from behind, holding the wooden clamps they had forgotten. “Then which bit am I?” she asked.
pairs.hanzi:
塔维想说总还是她先画的，苏苡却从后面追上来，手里拿着漏带的木夹。
“那我算哪一点？”她问。

pairs.target: mǐlā de liǎn yíxià hóng le . tǎ wéi tí zhe tǒng , zhōngyú zhēn qù zhǎoshuǐ , gěi tāmen liú le yìdiǎn dìfāng .
pairs.english: Mira flushed at once. Tavi finally went to fetch water for real, bucket in hand, leaving them some space.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉的脸一下红了。塔维提着桶，终于真去找水，给她们留了一点地方。

pairs.target: děng tā huílái , sū yǐ zuòzài dèngzǐ shàng , mǐlā zhèngzài zhǐ shàng xiězì . liǎnggè rén dōu méi kàn tā .
pairs.english: When he returned, Suyi was on a stool and Mira was writing on paper. Neither looked at him.
pairs.hanzi: 等他回来，苏苡坐在凳子上，米拉正在纸上写字。两个人都没看他。

pairs.target: zhǐ dǐng xiān xiě le tāmen gèzì zuò de dōngxī : hé tǐ hé tú , zhuāng qǔ shìyàn hé gǎi tí ěr . dǎobǎn páng liú le yìlán , zhǔnbèi xiě luò hēng shì cáo de chǐcùn .
pairs.english: At the top they had listed their respective work: box bodies and drawings, loading and removal tests and altered handles. Beside the guide plate they left a column for Lohen’s trough dimensions.
pairs.hanzi: 纸顶先写了她们各自做的东西：盒体和图，装取试验和改提耳。导板旁留了一栏，准备写洛亨试槽的尺寸。

pairs.target: mǐlā bǎ zhǐ tuī dào sū yǐ miànqián , ràng tā kànkàn zhèyàng xiě gòubugòu . sū yǐ méiyǒu mǎshàng jiē , xiān wèn nà fēng gěi fùqīn de xìn , yǒuméiyǒu tí zìjǐ .
pairs.english: Mira pushed the paper toward Suyi, asking if this was enough. Suyi did not take it at once; first she asked whether the letter to Mira’s father had mentioned her.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉把纸推到苏苡面前，让她看看这样写够不够。苏苡没有马上接，先问那封给父亲的信，有没有提自己。

pairs.target: " xiě le wǒmen . " mǐlā shuō . " kě tā bù zhīdào wǒmen shì shuí . "
pairs.english: “I wrote ‘we,’” Mira said. “But he does not know who ‘we’ are.”
pairs.hanzi:
“写了我们。”米拉说。
“可他不知道我们是谁。”

pairs.target: gōngpéng lǐ chuánlái páo mùtou de shēngyīn . tǎ wéi bǎ shuǐtǒng fàngdào qiángbiān , dītóu nǐnggān bù , tīngjiàn mǐlā shuō , nà jiù zài xiě yìfēng , xiě míngzì , yě bǎ shì de shíhòu shuí duān , shuí jì , shuí nòngshī le bàntiáo kùzǐ jiǎngqīngchǔ .
pairs.english: The sound of planing wood came from the workshop. Tavi set the bucket by the wall and bent to wring the cloth dry, hearing Mira say she would write again, with names, and explain who carried, who recorded and who soaked half her trousers during the tests.
pairs.hanzi: 工棚里传来刨木头的声音。塔维把水桶放到墙边，低头拧干布，听见米拉说，那就再写一封，写名字，也把试的时候谁端、谁记、谁弄湿了半条裤子讲清楚。

pairs.target: sū yǐ zhè cái ná qǐ zhǐ . tā méiyǒu shuō méiguānxì , zhī zài gǎi tí ěr nà yìháng hòumiàn tiān le zìjǐ de míngzì , bǐjiān yònglì , zhǐbèi tòuchū yìdiǎn hēi . mǐlā kànzhe nà yìxiǎo diǎn , méiyǒu shēnshǒu qù cā .
pairs.english: Only then did Suyi take the paper. She did not say it was all right, only added her name after the altered-handles entry, pressing hard enough to leave a black spot on the back. Mira watched the little spot without reaching to wipe it.
pairs.hanzi: 苏苡这才拿起纸。她没有说没关系，只在改提耳那一行后面添了自己的名字，笔尖用力，纸背透出一点黑。米拉看着那一小点，没有伸手去擦。

pairs.target: wǔfàn hòu , tāmen dài zhǐ qù jiè cáo . mǐlā méiyǒu bǎ gāngcái dehuà quán jiǎng yíbiàn , zhī shuō xīwàng shì wán néng bǎ tú gěi gōngfáng kàn , jiè le tā de dōngxī , yào zěnyàng xiě .
pairs.english: After lunch they brought the paper to borrow the trough. Mira did not repeat the whole earlier conversation, only saying she hoped to show the drawing to the works after testing, and asking how to acknowledge his equipment.
pairs.hanzi: 午饭后，她们带纸去借槽。米拉没有把刚才的话全讲一遍，只说希望试完能把图给工房看，借了他的东西，要怎样写。

pairs.target: luò hēng kàn le yíhuìer , shuō shì cáo kěyǐ xiě zìjǐ de míngzì , hézi búshì tā zuò de , búyòng .
pairs.english: Lohen looked for a while and said they could put his name on the trough, but not the boxes, which he had not made.
pairs.hanzi: 洛亨看了一会儿，说试槽可以写自己的名字，盒子不是他做的，不用。

pairs.target: " yàoshi shì chūshuǐ quán piān le ne ? " mǐlā wèn . " nà jiù xiě shuǐ quán piān le . "
pairs.english: “What if the test shows all the water veering to one side?” Mira asked. “Then write that all the water veered to one side.”
pairs.hanzi:
“要是试出水全偏了呢？”米拉问。
“那就写水全偏了。”

pairs.target: tā kàn tā yìyǎn , yòu shuō zìjǐ yuánlái nàtiáo kuài shuǐdào , shōukǒu fàngkuān hòu yě màn le , méishénme bùnéng gěi rén kàn de .
pairs.english: He glanced at her and added that his original fast channel had slowed too after widening its outlet; there was no reason to hide it.
pairs.hanzi: 他看她一眼，又说自己原来那条快水道，收口放宽后也慢了，没什么不能给人看的。

pairs.target: tāmen zài cáo lǐ gùdìng liǎngzhī hézi , xiān kāi xiǎo shuǐ . kuān yè tiēzhe dǎobǎn huáguòqù , dìèrpiàn yě guò le . mǐlā méi xiào , jiào sū yǐ zài tiānshuǐ , zhào shàngcì láide jí de shíhòu shì .
pairs.english: They fixed the two boxes in the trough and began with a small flow. A broad leaf slid along the guide plate, and a second passed too. Mira did not smile, asking Suyi to add water and repeat the earlier rush.
pairs.hanzi: 他们在槽里固定两只盒子，先开小水。宽叶贴着导板滑过去，第二片也过了。米拉没笑，叫苏苡再添水，照上次来得急的时候试。

pairs.target: dìsān piàn yèzi zhuàng shàng mùbǎn , yèbǐng guǒrán zhuǎn kāi , yèmiàn què tiē zài hé kǒu . shuǐ cóng lìngyìzhī hézi yǒng guòqù , yuánběn sàn zhe de shā bèi tuī chéng yìtiáo jǐ .
pairs.english: The third leaf hit the board; its stalk did turn aside, but its blade stuck over the box mouth. Water surged through the other box, pushing the loose sand into a ridge.
pairs.hanzi: 第三片叶子撞上木板，叶柄果然转开，叶面却贴在盒口。水从另一只盒子涌过去，原本散着的沙被推成一条脊。

pairs.target: luò hēng dūnxiàlái , méi pèng dǎobǎn , zhī wèn néng bunéng tíngshuǐ . mǐlā diǎntóu , tā guānshàng mù zhá . sū yǐ bǎ nà piàn yèzi lāochū , píng fàngzài zhǐbiān , shuǐzhū yìdiǎndiǎn yīn kāi .
pairs.english: Lohen crouched without touching the guide plate, asking only if he could stop the water. Mira nodded, and he closed the wooden gate. Suyi lifted out the leaf and laid it flat by the paper; droplets slowly spread.
pairs.hanzi: 洛亨蹲下来，没碰导板，只问能不能停水。米拉点头，他关上木闸。苏苡把那片叶子捞出，平放在纸边，水珠一点点洇开。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi hūrán kàn dǒng le , gāngcái guòqù de bìng búshì shuǐ hé yè dōu shùn , zhǐshì shuǐ hái búgòu duō .
pairs.english: Tavi suddenly understood: the earlier passage had not meant water and leaves both flowed freely, only that there had not been enough water yet.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维忽然看懂了，刚才过去的并不是水和叶都顺，只是水还不够多。

pairs.target: tāmen bǎ dǎobǎn yí duǎn , shì le sāngè wèizhì . zuìhòu yícì yèbǐng méi kǎ , shuǐ yě méiyǒu quán yā xiàng yìbiān , kě cáo dǐ réng liú zhe yì cuō shī shā .
pairs.english: They shortened the guide plate’s reach and tried three positions. In the last trial the stalk did not jam and the water did not all bear to one side, but a pinch of wet sand remained on the trough bottom.
pairs.hanzi: 他们把导板移短，试了三个位置。最后一次叶柄没卡，水也没有全压向一边，可槽底仍留着一撮湿沙。

pairs.target: luò hēng shuō zìjǐ dé yòng cáo le , mǐlā kàn le kàn tiānsè , kāishǐ chāi mù jiá , méiyǒu zài qiú yíbiàn .
pairs.english: Lohen said he needed the trough now. Mira glanced at the sky and began removing the clamps without asking again.
pairs.hanzi: 洛亨说自己得用槽了，米拉看了看天色，开始拆木夹，没有再求一遍。

pairs.target: huíqù shí , tā zhǔdòng ná le zhuāng shī mùpiàn de tǒng . sū yǐ jǔ zhe zhǐ , pà méi gān de mò cèng dào yīfu .
pairs.english: On the way back she volunteered to carry the bucket of wet wooden pieces. Suyi held the paper high, afraid the undried ink would rub onto her clothes.
pairs.hanzi: 回去时，她主动拿了装湿木片的桶。苏苡举着纸，怕没干的墨蹭到衣服。

pairs.target: zǒu dào gōngpéng ménkǒu , mǐlā zhuǎnshēn gàosù luò hēng , míngtiān huì bǎ jīntiān de jiéguǒ sòng tā yífèn . " bāokuò dìyīhuí . " tā shuō .
pairs.english: At the workshop door, Mira turned to tell Lohen she would bring him a copy of today’s results tomorrow. “Including the first run,” she said.
pairs.hanzi:
走到工棚门口，米拉转身告诉洛亨，明天会把今天的结果送他一份。
“包括第一回。”她说。

pairs.target: luò hēng diǎntóu , chóngxīn ná qǐ xì zhúpiàn . tǎ wéi zhè cái fāxiàn , tā gāngcái tíngxià de nà yìdāo , dào xiànzài hái méi xiāo wán .
pairs.english: Lohen nodded and picked up the thin bamboo strip again. Only then did Tavi realize the cut he had stopped making earlier was still unfinished.
pairs.hanzi: 洛亨点头，重新拿起细竹片。塔维这才发现，他刚才停下的那一刀，到现在还没削完。
